grammarHints.hint: For a verb: its stem (קַל, נִפְעַל, פִּעֵל, הִפְעִיל …), whether it is completed or ongoing (with the וַ of a narrative), or a command, an infinitive or a participle, and its person, gender and number. For a noun: its gender and number. Every part joined to it -- וְ "and", הַ "the", בְּ "in", לְ "to", כְּ "like", מִ "from", an ending -- named apart, with what it means.
